author: Dapo Olorunyomi
title: Kaduna Generates N90bn, Targets N120bn IGR In 2026
text:
Kaduna State has generated about N90 billion in internally generated income (IGR), leaving it N30 billion wanting its N120 billion goal for 2026, the state authorities has disclosed.
The Appearing Government Chairman of the Kaduna State Inner Revenue Service (KADIRS), Dr Mohammed Lawal, disclosed this on Thursday on the company’s third-quarter stakeholders’ engagement in Kafanchan.
Lawal expressed optimism that the state would surpass N100 billion by the tip of the 12 months and finally meet its N120 billion income goal.
The engagement centered on leveraging the Nigeria Tax Act 2025 and Nigeria Tax Administration Act 2025 to enhance income technology, taxpayers’ expertise and information compliance within the state.
Lawal attributed the expansion in income collections to successive tax reforms and enhancements within the state’s income administration system.
He recalled that Kaduna generated about N12 billion yearly earlier than the introduction of main tax reforms roughly 10 years in the past.
In response to him, the state recorded greater than N86 billion in income collections in 2025, representing a major enchancment in its income mobilisation.
The KADIRS boss stated stakeholder engagement had turn out to be a everlasting characteristic of the company’s administrative processes to acquire suggestions and handle challenges related to taxation.
He defined that Kaduna had carried out three main tax reforms inside the final decade, starting with the 2016 Tax Codification and Consolidation Legislation.
Lawal stated the 2016 reform abolished money collections, launched know-how into income administration and decreased the state’s income strains from greater than 400 to fewer than 50.
He added that the state consolidated its tax legal guidelines additional in 2020 earlier than introducing one other reform in 2025 to align with modifications within the federal tax system.
Describing the federal tax reforms as in depth, Lawal stated they consolidated a number of present tax legal guidelines and amended others to strengthen tax administration throughout the nation.
He recognized key areas of reform to incorporate private revenue tax, firm revenue tax, capital positive aspects tax, value-added tax and presumptive taxation.
He stated the reforms additionally launched 4 main legal guidelines offering frameworks for tax obligations, administration, income service operations and coordination.
Lawal added that the modifications had strengthened digital income administration, improved institutional organisation and inspired better collaboration amongst related authorities companies.
